messages:
rita (People Ops): Quick ops note for Review Week — please read. Deadlines and a couple new micro-processes so we don't scramble.

rita (People Ops): Key dates: review forms due TUES 11:59pm PDT (please hit submit even if you leave some fields blank). Calibration micro-sessions are THU/Fri — 15m slots only. If you need an exception (LOA, parental, travel), request by Mon COB and we9ll queue it for manual extension.

rita (People Ops): Managers: pre-fill the "manager summary" section before submitting the form. It helps calibrators and reduces follow-ups. Uploads: if you attach a PDF, name it "<last>-<name>-review.pdf".

rita (People Ops): Sign-up sheet for calibration slots: https://docs.google.com/sheet/review-calibration-signup — put your name + timezone. We9ll auto-assign overflow reviewers based on capacity. :calendar: :spiral_calendar:

sam (People Ops): Note on micro-sessions — we9re running them in two bands: 9:00–12:00 and 13:00–16:00 PT. Pick consecutive 15m slots if you want back-to-back. Signup limits: 3 slots per manager by default.

daniel (Eng Manager): Quick Q — for folks on partial parental leave, do we still need a full manager rating/review? or do we mark "limited data" and request extension?

rita (People Ops): @daniel mark "limited data" in the rating fields, add a short note under manager summary, and file the extension request (link in sheet). We9ll exclude them from calibration pool if extension granted. Keeps calibration focused and fair.

leah (IC): Are ICs able to see manager comments before calibration? Someone on my team wants to read it, wondering what the timing is.

sam (People Ops): IC visibility: managers can choose "share draft" — default is to keep manager comments internal until after calibration. If you want to share, use the checkbox on the form; be mindful that calibration may change outcomes.

ciaran (Eng): We9ll be overloaded — any suggested triage? We have 18 direct reports across 3 managers with 2 people OOO.

rita (People Ops): @ciaran suggest: 1) reserve 1 slot for a short canary calibration (2 examples), 2) use overflow queue (we9ll assign a floater reviewer), 3) for borderline cases, flag with the "needs discussion" tag in the sheet and drop 1 example in #review-ops for quick eyes. We9ll also publish a small calibration cheat-sheet later today.

sam (People Ops): FYI on CSV upload: if you export reviewer notes as CSV, please ensure the column header is exactly "manager_summary" (no caps). Otherwise the import fails and we have to do manual fixes. We9ll email a validator tool link in a few hours.

rita (People Ops): Small template snippet you can paste in manager_summary to reduce ambiguity:

```
Context: role + primary goals this cycle
Observed impact: 2-3 bullet examples (quant + qual)
Recommendation: rating + development note
```

rita (People Ops): Last thing — if you haven9t signed up for calibration by Wed noon, we9ll auto-assign based on timezone and manager load. Try to reserve your slots early. :alarm_clock:

hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: Review form deadline in 48 hours. Link: https://app.redwood/review-forms

daniel (Eng Manager): Thanks team. Will ping managers to pre-fill and sign up now.

leah (IC): +1 on the template, makes things cleaner.

ciaran (Eng): Thanks, will flag borderline cases in the sheet.

rita (People Ops): Appreciated — ping @sam or me in thread if anything breaks. We9ll post the cheat-sheet and the validator link in #review-ops shortly. :pray:
